To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) maximum matchings in doubly convex bipartite (and related) graphs can be found in linear time, (2) maximum matchings and maximum independent vertex sets in convex bipartites can be computed in O(m + n A(n)) time, and (3) the results of the previous two items can be extended to certain classes of graphs in scheduling theory.
maximum matchings can be found in convex bipartites in time O(m+ nA(n)) and in doubly convex bipartites (which include interval graphs) in time O(mn).
